auth_heading: Take a step back. At your own pace.
auth_intro: Log your cigarettes, follow your habits and keep track of your spending.
password_help: At least 12 characters to create an account.
heading: Every cigarette counts.
price_at_entry: At the price of each entry
empty_day_note: A day without entries does not necessarily mean no smoking.
forgot_entry: Missed an entry? Add it here.
search_timezone: Search by city, country or IANA identifier
price_note: The price and currency apply to new entries, including past consumption. Previous amounts keep their original currency; no exchange conversion is applied.
currency_price_hint: Enter the pack price in {0}. This does not convert the previous price.
api_note: A key grants access to your account. Use a dedicated key for Stream Deck. It expires after one year.
copy_key: Copy this key now: it will not be displayed again.
footer: Stop Clop · Your personal tracker, simply.
pending_entry: An entry is still unconfirmed. Retry the same action before adding another.
network_error: Unable to reach the server. Check your connection and retry.
server_address_error: Use an http(s) origin without a path or credentials.
android_https: The release app requires HTTPS. Debug builds accept HTTP for local network testing.
local_datetime: Local date and time: YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm
entry_zone_note: Time zone: {0}. The current price will apply.
web_integrations: API keys and CSV export are available in the web interface.
invalid_integer: {0} must be an integer between {1} and {2}.
rate_limit: Too many attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.
invalid_username: Username: 3–40 ASCII letters, digits, dots, hyphens or underscores.
username_taken: This username is already in use.
invalid_timezone: Select a time zone from the IANA catalog.
invalid_price: Enter a price from 0 to 1,000,000, with at most {0} decimal places for {1}.
price_required: Enter a new pack price when changing currency.
invalid_period: Select a past or current period of 1–366 days.
invalid_timestamp: Use an ISO 8601 date with a time zone.
invalid_entry_date: The date must be between 2000 and now.
initial_timezone: Initial time zone detected: {0}. You can change it in your preferences.
analysis_basis: Averages include every calendar day in the selected period, including days with no entries.
day_in_progress: Today is still in progress; comparisons are provisional.
analysis_range: Daily range: {0}–{1} cigarettes · {2} days with entries
widget_pin_help: Long-press your home screen, choose Widgets, then Stop Clop.
push_unavailable: Widget push is not configured on this server.
push_invalid_endpoint: Choose the ntfy server shown in the app, then enable synchronization again.
push_limit: Too many registered push sessions. Revoke unused sessions first.
push_registration_failed: Widget synchronization failed. Check ntfy and enable it again.
push_setup: Synchronization uses your Stop Clop account automatically. Allow notifications and unrestricted battery use to keep the widget updated while the screen is off. A persistent notification lets you stop synchronization at any time.
sync_notification_body: Keeping your home-screen counter up to date
sync_background_blocked: Open Stop Clop to resume synchronization.
chart_accessibility: Daily chart. Tap a day, use the day buttons or open daily figures to explore the values.
preferences_intro: Make this space yours. Preferences are shared across your devices.
